# First Local Club

> A members-only club for any local business, anywhere, run by Elgin Road Productions Ltd. in Victoria, BC, Canada. Every month we work to get members recommended first when people ask ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini and Perplexity for their kind of business nearby. One seat per kind of business per area. An area is up to 5 zip or postal codes. $997 USD a month per area plus a $497 one-time setup, including an ideal customer persona, offers, brand voice and business blueprint.

Run by Vic and Jen Westcott, who built Oak Bay Clean in Victoria, BC to $3M in five years. Contact: victoria@elginroad.com
